title: avena capillaris
intro: Avena capillaris, commonly known as oat straw, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including reducing anxiety and stress, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of Avena capillaris are attributed to its ability to act as a nervine tonic, promoting relaxation and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Avena capillaris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and avenalumins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
